system.description:
Battle Amp

You become a shadow wreathed beast of the night.

Nocturnal Wings. You gain a fly speed equal to your movement speed, with wings attached to your arms

Sonar. You always have the benefit of Echolocation, and can use Pinging once per turn, on your turn at no action cost.

Beast Claws. Your [Unarmed Damage], while in your Claws of the Night stance, increases by +2.

Fearless. If you begin your turn with 1 rank of Demoralized or Shaken, you reduce the ranks of said conditions to 0.

Crimson Feast. Once per turn, when you deal [Unarmed Damage] or [Weapon Damage] to a creature with ranks of Crimson Hemorrhage, you can reduce their ranks of said condition to 0. If you do, you regain 1d10 hit points for each rank removed.

Sonic Lance. As an Action, you can fire a 60-foot long, 5-foot-wide beam of destructive sound force. All creatures in the affected area must make a Constitution saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, they take 6d6 force damage and are Deafened until the end of their next turn, or half as much damage on a success.

Umbral Shockwave. As an Action, you release a Pulse of darkness centered on you, filling a 20-foot radius. Creatures in range must make a Wisdom saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. This counts as a Genjutsu, with the Visual, Auditory and Tactile keywords.

Success: Affected creature are Dazzled until the end of their next turn.

Failure: Affected creature are Blinded, until the end of their next turn.

Critical Failure: Same as failure, but are also Confused for the same duration.
system.summary: Fly speed, Echolocation and free Pinging. Unarmed +2 in Claws of the Night; Sonic Lance and Umbral Shockwave actions.

rules.text: Nocturnal Wings: fly speed equal to your speed (set at the table).
Entering again before a long rest: 1 rank of exhaustion.
